annotations.title: Configure Standalone Live Activity Social Proof Toast

description: Configure the standalone on-site Live Activity Social Proof Toast (corner notification card showing recent subscriber joins, logins, and purchases) and its 3 automated DOM/webhook sensors for an app_id without overwriting the In-App Promo Banner. Use this tool to enable/disable social proof toasts, change visual theme or screen corner, or toggle auto-capture sensors; do not use it for promo popups (use configure_inapp_banner instead). Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY and costs 0 credits. Returns JSON { ok, app_id, toast_enabled, toast_theme, toast_position, toast_action, sensors }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (obtain from list_apps)

toast_custom_body.description: Optional custom message body override for the Live Toast

toast_custom_html.description: Optional bespoke HTML/CSS markup when toast_theme='ai_custom'

toast_custom_title.description: Optional custom headline override for the Live Toast (leave empty to use automated sensor feed)

toast_custom_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL opened when toast_action='custom_url'

toast_enabled.description: Set true to enable Live Activity Toast on the website, or false to turn it off

toast_sensor_auth.description: Auto-detect signup/login forms on the website

toast_sensor_buy.description: Auto-detect checkout/payment forms and incoming payment webhooks

toast_sensor_sub.description: Auto-show toast when a new visitor subscribes to push notifications

name: configure_social_toast
